HW2 · Vectors and rotation

Olinde Rodrigues published his rotation formula in 1840, three years before Hamilton found quaternions.Rodrigues, Journal de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées, 1840
Out Thursday October 15 · due Wednesday October 21, 11:59 PM on Canvas · 25 points · Unity or WebGL · hub · schedule · syllabus · all homework
Read before this homework: Vectors §2 and §3, dot and cross · §5, lines · §6, planes and signed distance · Rotation §3, Rodrigues · §4, quaternions · Unity for This Course §7 · WebGL and three.js for This Course §7

What you build

The six exercises of the old vector labs as functions: march along a line, lay out a segment, build a plane, test which side of it a point is on, drop a shadow onto it, cut a segment with it and reflect the direction, and project a point onto a cylinder. Then rotation two ways: by the along/across split of Rodrigues' formula and by a quaternion, which must agree.

JavaScriptC#What it computes
marchStepMarchStepEX1: one frame of marching from p toward the line from → to at speed units per second.
lineFrameLineFrameEX1: the midpoint, unit direction and length of the segment p1 → p2.
planeFromPointPlaneFromPointEX2: the plane with normal direction m (any length) through q, as a unit normal n and D.
signedDistanceSignedDistanceEX3: n · p − D; positive on the normal's side.
shadowOnPlaneShadowOnPlaneEX4: p − (n · p − D) n.
linePlaneHitLinePlaneHitEX5: the point where the line through p1 and p2 crosses the plane; null (C#: false) when parallel.
reflectReflectEX5: d − 2 (d · n) n.
projectToCylinderProjectToCylinderEX6: the foot on the axis, pushed out to the radius; and whether the foot is within halfHeight of the center.
rotateAxisAngleRotateAxisAnglev rotated by deg about the axis: v∥ + cos θ v⊥ + sin θ (a × v⊥).
quatFromAxisAngleQuatFromAxisAngleThe unit quaternion (x, y, z, w) = (sin(θ/2) a, cos(θ/2)).
quatRotateQuatRotatev rotated by the quaternion: q v q*, or its expanded form v + 2w (u × v) + 2 u × (u × v).
  • A plane is (n, D) with n a unit normal: the points P with n · P = D.
  • Angles in degrees; a quaternion is [x, y, z, w] (a Vector4 in C#).

Implement and replace

Build each function from primitives (dot, cross, normalize, length, component access, + − × ÷, sin, cos, sqrt.) and use the engine's own helper, where one exists, only to check your result. These are off limits in your submission:

TrackOff limits
WebGL (JavaScript)Vector3.projectOnVector, projectOnPlane, reflect, applyAxisAngle, angleTo; THREE.Plane and THREE.Ray; Quaternion.setFromAxisAngle, applyQuaternion; quatFromAxisAngle and axisAngleMatrix from xform.js.
Unity (C#)Vector3.Project, ProjectOnPlane, Reflect, Angle, MoveTowards, Lerp; the Plane struct; Quaternion.AngleAxis and quaternion × vector.

Getting started

WebGL track.
  1. Download the course site: its repository (Code, then Download ZIP), or git clone it.
  2. From the site's root folder run python3 -m http.server 8000 and open http://localhost:8000/homework/run.html?hw=hw02.
  3. Edit lib/skeletons/hw02.js, the only file you change, and reload: the Checks table under the scene compares your numbers with the ones below.

The unfilled skeleton runs on this site too, so you can see the page before you start. The setup, the blank page a file opened from disk gives, and how to read the Checks table are in WebGL and three.js for This Course.

Unity track.
  1. In Unity Hub, create a new project with the 3D (Built-In Render Pipeline) template in editor 6000.3.11f1.
  2. From the same download, copy the files in homework/hw02/unity/ into Assets/HW02/.
  3. Create an empty GameObject, add the Checks component (namespace CSS551.HW02), and press Play: the Console lists every check with your value and the expected one.
  4. Edit HW02.cs; the other files are given.

The Unity files compile against a stand-in for the UnityEngine API and pass their checks with the reference solution, but they are new this quarter and have not yet been opened in the Unity editor. If one does not compile in 6000.3.11f1, post the error on the Canvas board and use the WebGL track meanwhile.

Submitting and grading

  • WebGL: the one file hw02.js.
  • Unity: the project folder, zipped, without Library/, Temp/, Logs/ and obj/.

Grading runs your functions twice: on the published inputs above and on a second set of inputs that is not published. A check earns its points only when your value is within its tolerance on both, so the numbers have to come from the math. The rubric score is the sum of the points earned, out of 100; it counts as 25 course points (the rubric score divided by 4). A submission that does not load or compile earns no check points. Name any collaborators and tools in the submission comment.

Late tokens. You have two for the quarter. Declare one in the submission comment to extend this homework by 48 hours without penalty. Without a token, late work is not accepted, and nothing is accepted after Friday, December 11.
